records.text: CERN was established in 1954 to research particle physics.
records.speaker: Mark (Candace show producer; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: And I just want to preface by saying I am not a particle physicist. So I'm just I just use particle physics recreationally. I'm a high school dropout. This is all on my own. But CERN was basically established in 1954 to research particle physics.

verification.notes: CERN's official history states that the organization began in 1954 and that fundamental physics has been its core business; CERN describes its main research area as particle physics.

sources.title: Our History — CERN
sources.relevance: Official CERN history confirms its 1954 establishment and fundamental/particle-physics research mission.
